body:
`frontend/src/pages/Reader.tsx`: the note composer renders the four highlight
swatches and `setComposer((s) => (s ? { ...s, color: c } : s))` updates its local
state when one is clicked. In `edit` mode `commitNote` then PATCHes **only**
`note_text` and calls `repaintHighlight(c.cfiRange, c.color, ...)`.

So clicking a swatch while writing a note visibly recolours the highlight and
the change is never sent. It survives until the next reload, then reverts.

Pre-existing; unrelated to the colour-vocabulary work in F-5769c9 (found by an
adversarial review pass over that diff, not caused by it). Two candidate fixes:
either include `highlight_color` in the edit PATCH when the composer's colour
differs from the row's, or do not offer the swatches in `edit` mode at all —
the dedicated recolour popover already exists and does persist
(`recolorHighlight`).

The second is probably right: two surfaces that both look like they set the
colour, where only one does, is the confusion underneath the bug.

NOT verified in a browser — read from the source.
title: The SPA reader's note composer repaints a recolour it never persists
